description: This file defines the AWSAgentCoreProcessor class, which facilitates invoking Amazon Bedrock AgentCore agents, managing the payload creation, response handling, and response streaming as frames within a processing pipeline.

classes.name: AWSAgentCoreProcessor
classes.description: A processor class that manages invoking Amazon Bedrock AgentCore agents, handling payload creation, response streaming, and conversion into text frames within a processing framework.

methods.name: _close_output_response_after_timeout(self)
methods.description: Asynchronous method to close the output response stream after a specified timeout if no new text frames are generated.

methods.name: _push_text_frame(self, text: str)
methods.description: Handles pushing a text frame to the pipeline, managing start/end frames for response streaming, and scheduling timeout closing.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Main method that processes incoming frames; if context frames are received, it invokes the AgentCore agent asynchronously, handles streamed responses, and converts response lines into text frames.
